entities.name: Red-green color blindness
observations: For an X-linked recessive trait affecting 1 in 200 males, the mutant allele frequency is approximately q=1/200.
Under Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium, the unaffected female carrier frequency is approximately 2pq≈1/100.
For a phenotypically unaffected couple, affected-child risk is (1/100)×(1/2 male)×(1/2 transmission)=1/400.

entities.name: Affected child risk 1/400
observations: An apparently unaffected couple has approximately a 1/400 risk of a child with X-linked red-green color blindness when affected males occur at frequency 1/200.
